Ananya Das
ananya.das.cs@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx05 | github.com/ananyadas | Kolkata
SUMMARY
Backend developer with a strong grasp of Python and Django. Comfortable building REST APIs and working with
relational databases; has not worked with React or Node.js.
EDUCATION
B.E. Information Science, BMS College of Engineering (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.4/10
SKILLS
Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Git, basic HTML/CSS, Postman
PROJECTS
Campus Lost & Found Portal
•
Built with Django and Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL as the database
•
Server-rendered templates with Django (no separate JS frontend framework)
Blog API
•
REST API built with DRF supporting CRUD operations and token authentication
CERTIFICATIONS
Python for Everybody (Coursera)
